label: private customer RFP and contract corpus (208 documents, 105 cases)

judge_v3_correct_vs_blind_grades.in_sample: the v3 prompt was written after seeing these grades; the agreement is not an out-of-sample measurement

judge_v3_correct_2026-11-25.mostly_ai_graded: 25 of the 39 scored answers were graded only by an AI assistant
judge_v3_correct_2026-11-25.caveats: All 14 human grades are yes. The AI disputes 4 of them (3 no-information or no-exception answers the source contradicts, 1 that misses the point asked) and had seen them before grading, so claude_all is not independent on those 14; its grades were blind to the judge. One more answer was flagged by the human, not graded, and is among the 25. 21 of the 40 questions are among those v3 was designed on, so this is not a held-out measurement. Split that way, the 25 AI-only grades agree 0.85 (bias +0.08, n=13) on design questions and 0.58 (bias +0.21, n=12) on the others. The judge gave 1 answer no verdict.

calibration.faithfulness: uncalibrated: no human faithfulness grades exist for judge v3

notes: answer_correct is judged by mistral with prompt v3, which grades against the reference alone. Its agreement with blind grades by an AI assistant (0.85 exact, +0.07 bias; 0.94 on qwen2.5:14b answers) is in-sample: v3 was designed and chosen on those grades. A 2026-11-25 check, mostly AI-graded, reads lower: see calibration. Human calibration stays open.
faithfulness is uncalibrated: no human faithfulness grades exist for judge v3. 16 of 105 cases got no usable faithfulness verdict and 1 no correctness verdict; both means are over the scored cases.
The judge saw the whole context the answer model saw. The 2026-11-22 run, which cut it at 6000 characters, read faithfulness 0.659 on the same retrieval; this run reads 0.792.
